text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The new year arrived, and entering the 
Classic Class at last—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year, everyone~! Please take 
good care of me this year too♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As part of her efforts to gain more fans, 
Vivlos was holding a fan meeting. Today, 
fans could talk with Vivlos one-on-one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos treated all the fans who had 
gathered without showing any favoritism, 
and—

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Waaah...! In person, you're so cu...! I-I 
always watch your UmaToks!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Thank you~! Will you cheer for me in the 
race too?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Gyah... Of course!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Thank you~♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I have great eyesight... so I'll make sure 
to spot you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Gya-gyah! Th-They're definitely in there!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yup, promise♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While there used to be a lot of Verxina 
fans and people just following the hype, 
it seems Vivlos has begun gaining fans of 
her own.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And right then—

text_block_list.name: Verxina's Fan
text_block_list.text: Vivlos! Hello!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Huh, wait... Were you at my debut race 
too?

text_block_list.name: Verxina's Fan
text_block_list.text: ! You remembered?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Of course! You're one of my big sister's 
fans, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "Aaaand now you're my fan, aren't you♡"

text_block_list.name: Verxina's Fan
text_block_list.text:
B-Both of them! Because Vivlos will be 
running in the Tiara route...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina's Fan
text_block_list.text:
I watched all of Verxina's races in 
person. ...Of course, the Tiara route 
included.

text_block_list.name: Verxina's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"During the Shuka Sho, when Gentildonna 
closed in down the home stretch... her run 
was so ferociously intense that I thought 
the victory was hers."

text_block_list.name: Verxina's Fan
text_block_list.text:
I had given up. But... Right before my 
eyes, I saw Verxina dig deep and fight 
back when she was about to be passed!

text_block_list.name: Verxina's Fan
text_block_list.text:
—Through pure stubborn will to win, she 
pushed it to a photo finish. Her 
expression in that moment... is forever 
burned into my mind.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. I've... never forgotten either.

text_block_list.name: Verxina's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"...Truth be told, I was worried it would 
be a burden, but... still!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina's Fan
text_block_list.text:
—You're going to get revenge for Verxina, 
aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Verxina's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Then this time, I will stake my entire 
being... and cheer you on! Please, I'm 
counting on you...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I'm sorry, I got carried away...! 
Anyway, I'll be cheering for you even 
harder next year!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ah... Y-Yeah, thank you~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: *Gulp, gulp...*

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa, I talked so much! My mouth is 
totally parched!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah, thank you~. ...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, that's not it...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...My big sis's fans sure had incredible 
passion!"
choice_data_list:
Ah... Were you there for the debut race 
too?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That person, and everyone else who came 
because of Big Sis.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone reeeaaallly... loves Big Sis so 
much, don't they!"
choice_data_list:
Because she's a great big sister, after 
all.

Because she's a great big sister, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah, for real!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...I think I kinda understand why my big 
sis was worrying so much now."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Still, Trainy. I'm really happy!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
There are so many people who love my big 
sis just as much as I do as her family!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna show you what it looks like when 
I win the Triple Tiara♡"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at Vivlos's positive expression, 
instead of feeling pressure, I felt as if 
I were being cheered on.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Alright, break's over! What should we do 
next?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Feeling good♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"We haven't done anything New Year-sy 
yet~. I wanna do something celeb-like, you 
know?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Got any ideas from your perspective, 
Trainie~?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
A workout... is just training in the end, 
isn't it~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The plan was to lower the load compared to 
regular training and just lightly move 
around. I thought it'd be a refreshing 
start to the new year, but...
choice_data_list:
If you want to rest, should we call it a 
day?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, wait a sec... Working out right from 
New Year's Day...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Post with '#workout'... Oh, looks 
pretty good, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Shall we do it? ♡ It totally feels like 
'the vibe,' anyway ♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Trainie! Let's take a pic! For Umastagram 
with '#workout'♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the compliant Vivlos enjoyed a fun 
workout to kick off the New Year.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Leisure time...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, don't tell me, you're taking me 
to a resort?!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Doesn't look like it, huh? Hmm, if it's 
not the location...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Are you saying you'll accompany me, 
Trainy!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
choice_data_list: Lady Vivlos, I've brought your tea

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "Just leave it over there. ......"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Aww, this feels sooo good! Keep going, 
keep going♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I don't really get it, but Vilshina 
seemed to find it very relaxing.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Conversation skills?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her communication skills, being able to 
talk to anyone without distinction, are 
truly wonderful. That said, a celebrity 
also needs a sense of elegance.
choice_data_list:
Things like how to speak properly in 
public settings

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Really?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainy... You were actually 
lonely without me, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Excuses, excuses~ Didn't you really just 
want to chat with me?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Sure! Time for a one-on-one talk with 
Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hello~♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Huh, are you nervous? You can just act 
like your usual self, you know?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for coming today! What's your 
favorite thing about me?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Eeeh, that's all? Give me more, please?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ah! It ran away~.
